newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P MAY DOWNGRADE POSCO LONG-TERM CREDIT RATING.
newsitem.headline: S&P MAY DOWNGRADE POSCO LONG-TERM CREDIT RATING.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp said on Thursday that it had placed its A+ long-term credit rating of Pohang Iron & Steel Co Ltd on credit watch with negative implications.
POSCO's credit quality could deteriorate if the company succeeded in acquiring the assets of the failed Hanbo Steel Co from creditor banks, S&P said in a statement.

Even if the rating was changed, it was not likely to fall below A because of the benefits deriving from POSCO's dominant position in the Korean steel market, its highly efficient, low-cost production facilities, and strong cash flow from operations, S&P said.
POSCO would be removed from credit watch once the situation regarding the Hanbo Steel sale became clear, S&P said.
